en.title: ZHFLU-Union Website
en.summary: Union information site with clear navigation and member resources.
en.challenge: A labor union needed an accessible public information hub that members could navigate easily and maintain through a simple deployment workflow.
contribution: Designed and built the responsive information architecture, content pages, and interaction patterns.
Connected GitHub source control to AWS Amplify deployment and the production domain.
Structured member resources so important information could be found without a complex CMS.
technical: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript keeps the public site fast, portable, and inexpensive to operate.
GitHub provides versioned content and code; AWS Amplify builds and deploys each approved update.
Domain routing exposes the published site to members and the public.

architecture.label: Source
architecture.detail: Website code and content are versioned in GitHub.

architecture.label: Build
architecture.detail: AWS Amplify detects changes and produces the static deployment.

architecture.label: Hosting
architecture.detail: Amplify serves the generated assets through managed web infrastructure.

architecture.label: Domain
architecture.detail: DNS connects the public zhflu.org address to the hosted site.

outcomes: Delivered a responsive public resource for union information and member content.
Established a straightforward source-to-production deployment path.
Kept operations simple by choosing static delivery for a content-focused requirement.

zh.title: 中華職工總工會網站
zh.summary: 為工會打造清晰導覽與會員資源的資訊網站。
zh.challenge: 工會需要易於瀏覽的公共資訊中心，讓會員能快速找到內容，並透過簡單部署流程維護網站。
contribution: 設計並建立響應式資訊架構、內容頁面與互動模式。
將 GitHub 原始碼控制串接 AWS Amplify 部署與正式網域。
整理會員資源，讓重要資訊不需複雜 CMS 也能容易被找到。
technical: 靜態 HTML／CSS／JavaScript 讓公開網站維持快速、可攜且低營運成本。
GitHub 提供版本化內容與程式碼；AWS Amplify 建置並部署每次核准的更新。
網域路由將已發布網站提供給會員與一般大眾。

architecture.label: 原始碼
architecture.detail: 網站程式碼與內容在 GitHub 中進行版本控制。

architecture.label: 建置
architecture.detail: AWS Amplify 偵測變更並產生靜態部署。

architecture.label: 託管
architecture.detail: Amplify 透過受管理的網站基礎設施提供產生後的檔案。

architecture.label: 網域
architecture.detail: DNS 將公開的 zhflu.org 網址連接至託管網站。

outcomes: 交付響應式公共資源，提供工會資訊與會員內容。
建立清楚直接的原始碼至正式環境部署路徑。
針對內容導向需求選擇靜態交付，維持簡單營運。
